svg.title: Self-Hypnosis at a Glance — updated guide map

text.tspan: A gentle guide to inner communion across mind, body, parts, and adult choice
Gather. Listen. Respond. Return. Integrate. Act.
Protectors are heard — not assumed behind every
Higher Self / universal heart may offer coherence;
Cherish the inner child’s gifts without handing it
NLP as listening tools, never manipulation
HIGHER SELF / UNIVERSAL HEART: optional coherence, love, perspective
The present-day adult leads; every signal remains open to checking.
If these capacities feel unavailable: witness first; borrow one narrow function;
choose and perform one small action yourself; name what you carried.
Outside support can stand beside judgment; it does not replace it.
For ordinary distracted or analytical states: gather attention.
Already open, trancey, emotional, or altered? Stabilize before deepening.
Escape-prone, sleepy, dissociative, or daydreamy? Increase clarity.
Heart + solar plexus: warmth, listening, adult presence.
Full alertness is a valid version of the practice.
Aim for the amount of trance that suits the practice.
Depth is optional. Sleep is separate.
THE BASIC PROCESS — FOLLOW WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENS
The next invitation follows the response you got — not the response a script expected.
Fifteen minutes is an appointment, not a timetable.
• Enter briefly — or remain alert if that fits better.
• Listen and respond at the pace the material allows.
• Reserve several minutes to come all the way back.
• Note what happened and what remains uncertain.
• Take one ordinary action if the session calls for one.
• Use the app to learn, develop language, reflect, and ask questions.
• Safe prompts include a real fallback: silence, rest, change, or stop.
• NLP is optional; if wording feels fake or controlling, change it.
• If no protector or part appears, do not invent one — stay with what is there.
• Seek outside help when stability, reality-testing, or functioning worsens.
“Bring back only what is useful now.”
